score.description: The player's final score for the game.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the game (easy, medium, hard, zen).

theme.description: The theme used for the game blocks/towers.

event_log.description: A JSON array of events that occurred during the game.

wave_reached.description: The highest wave number reached in the game.

towers_built.description: The total number of towers built during the game.
